answer: Throttle identity issuance: each epoch opens only a fixed number of registration slots, sold by sealed-bid auction, and every winning bid sits in a vault for 90 days before withdrawal. A farmer wanting a tide of fake agents must outbid honest newcomers slot by slot while his capital stays frozen, so cost grows with every clone. Like scaling a mesa, standing is earned slowly: reputation never transfers between keys, so each clone starts at zero.
